title: For representable morphisms, limit preservation on objects equals local finite presentation

standard_prerequisites.name: Characterization of locally finite presentation
standard_prerequisites.use: Descends morphisms along directed limits of affines in the (2)=>(1) direction.

standard_prerequisites.name: Surjection criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Yields local finite presentation from surjectivity of the colimit map in the (1)=>(2) direction.

core_obligations: Direction (2) => (1): represent the 2-fibre product by X_{y_i}, translate the given data to a morphism f_xi via 2-Yoneda, descend it to f_{i'} and transport back to an object x_{i'} with the two isomorphisms.
Direction (1) => (2): translate morphisms U -> X_y into isomorphism classes of pairs (x, alpha) via 2-Yoneda and read off surjectivity of the colimit map, then invoke the surjection criterion.
proof_roadmap: Both directions pair data with morphisms through the 2-Yoneda lemma; (2)=>(1) descends the morphism along the limit, (1)=>(2) reads off the colimit surjectivity and quotes the criterion.
difficulty_reason: Two symmetric directions, each a 2-Yoneda bookkeeping reduction; the descent machinery is quoted.
